findings.description: The Lambda environment variables contain an AWS access key and secret access key in plain text directly in the Terraform source. Secrets embedded in function configuration are readable by anyone with describe permissions on the resource, and credentials committed to IaC/source must be treated as compromised. These should be retrieved from a secret store (e.g., AWS Secrets Manager / SSM Parameter Store) or injected via encrypted references, never stored in plain text.

The function uses runtime 'nodejs12.x', which has reached end-of-life and is no longer patched by AWS. Deprecated runtimes stop receiving security patches while continuing to execute, leaving the function exposed to known vulnerabilities in the runtime. A currently supported runtime version should be used.
